sections.title: Everything *for the event*
sections.intro: Prices change with the season and the size of the event, so call or email for a quote on your date.

items.title: Tents
items.text: Frame tents from 10×10 to 30×130, and pole tents up to 60×180.

items.title: Chairs
items.text: Chiavari, crossback, Louis XIV and padded chairs, plus benches and barstools.

items.title: Tables & linens
items.text: Tables for every layout, and linens in colors from ivory and gold to gingham.

items.title: China & catering
items.text: China, flatware, glassware, chafers, coffee urns and beverage dispensers.

items.title: Lighting & sound
items.text: Edison and bistro lights, lanterns, chandeliers, uplights, podiums and PA systems.

items.title: Wedding décor
items.text: Arches, columns, a boxwood champagne wall, cathedral windows and cake stands.

items.title: Dance floors & staging
items.text: Parquet, white and wood-plank dance floors, staging and risers.

items.title: Heating & cooling
items.text: HVAC units to keep a tent comfortable in any season.

items.title: Restrooms & fencing
items.text: Portable restrooms, fencing, and pipe and drape.

sections.title: Weddings to *Masters week*
sections.intro: From an elegant small affair to the ten-day Western Carolina State Fair, we help plan the layout and bring everything it needs.

items.text: This company’s attention to detail surpasses any other of their kind in the CSRA. They continue to go above and beyond to help make the Western Carolina State Fair happen.

sections.title: AllStar *gets it right*

image.alt: The AllStar Tents & Events showroom: a white building with black awnings under a blue sky

body: AllStar Tents & Events started in 2004 as a small party rental company and has grown to handle large events all over the Southeast.
Weddings and corporate events are a big part of the business. Our event specialists guide you through renting, help lay out the space, and deliver wherever the party is.
list: Showroom visits by appointment, Monday to Friday
Propane tanks and refills at the office

items.title: Call or visit
items.text: Tell us the date, the place and roughly how many guests.

items.title: Plan the layout
items.text: We help choose the tent, tables and extras, with a site survey if you need one.

items.title: We deliver
items.text: Near or far, your rentals arrive for the big day.

items.a: We serve the CSRA and many surrounding counties and cities, and we handle large events all over the Southeast.

items.q: Can I see the rentals first?
items.a: Yes. The showroom is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm, by appointment.
Yes. Stop by the office for a new tank or a refill.
